symptoms: Our global network is experiencing a severe disruption.
Approximately 85% of our network is returning errors.
Our monitoring detected the global disruption within one minute of its onset.
visible_during_incident.dependent_impact: Our customers' services and the people who rely on them are also affected by the network errors.
visible_during_incident.scope: Global disruption affecting approximately 85% of our network.
visible_during_incident.timing: The disruption began suddenly at 09:47 UTC and was detected by our monitoring at 09:48 UTC.
already_tried: Our monitoring detected the global disruption at 09:48 UTC, one minute after onset.
We investigated the disruption and identified the relevant customer configuration at 10:27 UTC, before services began recovering.

complete_message: We're experiencing a sudden global disruption in our edge delivery network, with approximately 85% of the network returning errors. The problem started at 09:47 UTC, and our monitoring detected it one minute later. We don't yet know what changed immediately before the disruption.

conversation.analyst: We're suddenly seeing errors across a large portion of our network.
Our global edge delivery network is affected. Approximately 85% of the network is returning errors.

conversation.if_asked_about: what changed right before / the trigger
conversation.analyst: We don't know yet what changed right before the disruption.

conversation.if_asked_about: when it started and who is affected
conversation.analyst: The disruption started suddenly at 09:47 UTC, and our monitoring detected it at 09:48 UTC. The impact is global, affecting approximately 85% of our network, our customers, and people relying on their services.
Approximately 85% of our global network is returning errors. Our monitoring confirms a widespread disruption.

discovered_later.root_cause: A previously undiscovered software bug had been introduced during an earlier software deployment. The bug could be triggered by a specific customer configuration under specific circumstances. A customer pushed a valid configuration change that met those conditions, triggering the bug and causing 85% of the global network to return errors.
fix: Identified and isolated the triggering customer configuration.
Disabled the configuration responsible for triggering the bug.
Impacted services began recovering at 10:36 UTC.
Approximately 95% of the network was operating normally within 49 minutes of the initial disruption.
The majority of services had recovered by 11:00 UTC, and the incident was mitigated at 12:35 UTC.
Developed a permanent software fix and began deploying it at 17:25 UTC.
prevention: Deploy the permanent bug fix across the network as quickly and safely as possible.
Conduct a complete post-mortem review of the processes and practices followed during the incident.
Investigate why software quality assurance and testing processes failed to detect the bug.
Evaluate ways to improve incident remediation time.
Invest in fundamental platform resilience improvements, leveraging WebAssembly isolation capabilities.
discovered_later.changes: An earlier software deployment introduced the latent bug. A later valid customer configuration change triggered it. During mitigation, the triggering configuration was disabled. A permanent software bug fix was developed, and deployment began at 17:25 UTC. The post-mortem does not specify the exact code or configuration changes.
